_comment: How scripts/generate-examples.sh builds this example from the skill's assets/. namespace = the fixed namespace the <Namespace> placeholder is substituted for; placeholders = the skill's other placeholders, resolved to values that exist in the reference instance (Clean ships an 'Error' node of Document Type alias 'error' as a direct child of the site root, which is exactly the shape both assets navigate to); assets = the chosen-approach files to include (Approach A: IContentLastChanceFinder — Approach B is config-only, so there is no C# to compile).
